sender.en: A survey company, or an ad using your bank’s name

name.en: Paid survey or “test a banking app” offer that takes over your account

how.en: While browsing, or after an AI search for quick ways to earn money, you see an ad offering easy cash for a short survey or for testing a banking app, sometimes with your bank’s name on it. You are moved to a chat app and given step-by-step instructions: download software, share your screen, log in to your banking app and share one-time passcodes. The criminals use this to take money from your account.

text.en: An ad offers easy cash for a survey or testing a banking app.
You are moved to a chat app with step-by-step instructions.
They ask you to download software or share your screen.
They ask you to log in to your bank and share passcodes.

Welcome to the app tester programme! Task 1 pays €40: install the screen viewer from the link, open your banking app so our team can check the layout, and read out the 6-digit code you get to confirm the test.

en: paid survey asked me to log into my bank
test a banking app for money
survey job asked me to share my screen
earn money testing apps asked for my code
they wanted me to install software for a survey
Being paid to log in to your bank while someone watches.
Being asked to share your screen, install software or read out codes.
Easy money for very little work.
Stop. Never share your screen, passwords or one-time passcodes.
If you logged in or shared codes, call your bank straight away.

sources.title: Beware of paid survey scams that put your bank account at risk
